announcements.title: StegZ 1.4 for Windows
announcements.message:
• Credits to Havenova X in Settings (click to visit)
• "Don't show this again" on announcements
• Text editor, archive previews and instant archive opening
Tip: press F1 for the Help guide.

announcements.title: StegZ 2.3 for Android
announcements.message:
• Task popups with Hide/Cancel, a Tasks screen and live notifications
• Search and sort in every file chooser; create files and folders
• Hidden pictures and extracted media appear in your Gallery
• StegZ now shows in "Open with" and Share ("Locate file")
• Text/code editor, PDF, audio, video and image viewers, OBB install, Help guide
Made by Havenova X
